[message_id=682197 author=ISAKA Tsuyoshi first=True]
When saving and committing a notebook via the Kaggle API, the GPU is automatically set to P100.
Is there a way to set it to RTX Pro 6000 instead?

[message_id=3422892 author=c-number first=False]
I haven't checked myself, but this may work.
https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/kernels.md#:~:text=NvidiaH100-,NvidiaRtxPro6000,-Some%20of%20these

[message_id=3423144 author=ISAKA Tsuyoshi first=False]
It worked with @cnumber ’s method! Thank you!
I’d also like to thank @ravi20076 and @luciankucera for their comments.

[message_id=3423644 author=YashasGunderia first=False]
hey, comment link?

[message_id=3422875 author=lucian kucera first=False]
No there is no way. Just use kaggle notebooks.

[message_id=3423028 author=Ravi Ramakrishnan first=False]
@isakatsuyoshi use kaggle notebooks - this is the easiest and safest way to ensure A6000 is selected
